POLO 2.4.4 — POLO Community & Crosshair Studio Refinement

- NEW: POLO Community accounts backed by Cloudflare D1: registration, sign-in, privacy modes and server-issued sessions protected with Windows DPAPI on this device.
- NEW: Identity, Rewards, Leaderboards and Premium appearance sections stay inside Account; earned badges and streaks are never inferred from editable local data.
- NEW: Official badge collection supports three free local showcase slots for badges actually issued by the Community service.
- NEW: Community ranking can switch between all-time streak, current streak and active days. Public, anonymous and hidden visibility are enforced by the server.
- IMPROVED: Crosshair Studio has clearer secondary-text contrast, a stronger cyan selected tab, larger/glowing reticle previews, aligned editor values and consistent compact action controls.
- IMPROVED: An enabled crosshair is now labelled as an active overlay with a subtle red disable control; green remains reserved for verified or healthy states.
- IMPROVED: Crosshair game mappings, warnings, sliders, switches and import/export cards have more consistent spacing and readable status treatments.

Community streaks and badges only change through the server-side verified-activity route. Creating an account, opening POLO or modifying local preferences does not create score, badges or leaderboard activity.

---

POLO 2.4.3 — Home Command Surface V3

- NEW: Home V3 decision surface with honest readiness, coverage, confidence and freshness states.
- NEW: POLO NEXT ranks one evidence-based next action with source, risk, confidence and dismiss-for-24-hours context.
- NEW: Dynamic System Pulse shows up to four relevant measured categories instead of a permanent evidence wall.
- NEW: Quick and Full System Check flows reuse native system, hardware and Windows read-only scanners.
- NEW: Desktop/laptop adaptation, cached laptop power status and active-session awareness.
- NEW: Sidebar groups reorganized into Performance, Hardware and Tools; Ctrl+K includes contextual benchmark, network, controller, crosshair and recovery actions.
- IMPROVED: Home copy responds to Spanish, English and Dutch settings, including readiness states and manual-check feedback.
- IMPROVED: Responsive, compact, high-contrast and reduced-motion layouts.

No Windows or optimization setting is changed automatically from Home. Missing, stale or unsupported evidence remains explicitly labeled.

- NEW: DNS selection (Cloudflare, Google, Quad9 or automatic IPv4), actual adapter readback, confirmation and a saved restore point. IPv6 is preserved.
- NEW: M-Lab NDT7 download/upload tests with explicit privacy consent, cancellation and bounded timeouts. Latency, jitter and loss remain separate measurements.
- NEW: Three NVIDIA controls (OpenGL threading, driver FXAA off and application-controlled anisotropic filtering) and two TCP controls (RSC and ECN). Unsupported settings stay unavailable.
- NEW: Three Fortnite graphics settings for existing configuration keys: textures, view distance and anti-aliasing, with visual trade-offs and backups.
- NEW: Three optional NVIDIA/AMD shader-cache cleanup categories for files older than 30 days. Rebuilding shaders can cause temporary stutter; these are not preselected.
- Larger Startup Manager text and clearer network buttons; adapter inventory no longer starts automatically.
- Premium 3D setup retained. Paths with spaces use the NSIS-compatible argument format, with protected-folder checks.
- Spanish and Dutch copy expanded for the new network controls.

M-Lab collects the public IP and publishes measurement data. Speed tests can use substantial data and do not guarantee the speed of your Internet plan. Bufferbloat/loaded-latency grades are not calculated. DNS does not increase your plan's bandwidth. POLO does not claim universal FPS or ping gains.
